topic.label: Claude Duet
topic.desc: Claude Duet: Main chat and replies (Claude Duet), Task threads, Channels (Claude Duet), Tasks page, Morning brief and check-ins, Routines and reminders, Memory and standing rules (Claude Duet) and Connected apps, drafts and approvals.

concepts.label: Connected apps, drafts and approvals
concepts.desc: Mail, calendar, chat and file connectors and a browser for websites, with drafts the person approves before anything is sent, paid, signed or deleted, and pages or docs as results.

concepts.label: Morning brief and check-ins
concepts.desc: A short brief when quiet hours end, and check-ins through the day when something in the connected apps needs the person.

concepts.label: Channels (Claude Duet)
concepts.desc: A separate chat for one lasting subject, such as a project or a move, with its own tasks, files and notes.

concepts.label: Main chat and replies (Claude Duet)
concepts.desc: The one ongoing conversation the person texts or talks to: a short answer first, or a line that longer work has started on a task.

concepts.label: Memory and standing rules (Claude Duet)
concepts.desc: What Claude keeps about the person between sessions: goals, rules in their own words, preferences and open loops, which they can ask to see, correct or forget.

concepts.label: Routines and reminders
concepts.desc: Work that runs on a schedule: routines that repeat, one-time reminders, and watches that look at set times.

concepts.label: Task threads
concepts.desc: Longer work on one task runs in its own thread, with a live status checklist and a report when the work stops for the person or finishes.

concepts.label: Tasks page
concepts.desc: Where every task stands: working, ready for the person, stopped, or resolved, with its steps, its question and its outcome.

skills.label: Approve a draft before it is sent
skills.desc: Look at a drafted message with every recipient, edit it if needed, and press Send; nothing in your name goes out, gets paid or gets deleted without your yes.

skills.label: Connect an app
skills.desc: Connect mail, calendar, chat, files or a work tool so Claude can read them and draft for you.

skills.label: Get a page or a doc as the result
skills.desc: Ask for a document, plan or report and get it as a doc or page you can open, edit and share.

skills.label: Read the morning brief
skills.desc: Read the brief that arrives when quiet hours end: what needs the person today, from mail, calendar and open tasks.

skills.label: Set quiet hours and the time zone
skills.desc: Choose the hours when no brief or check-in arrives, and the time zone that times are read in.

skills.label: Turn the brief and check-ins off or on
skills.desc: Switch the morning brief and check-ins off when unasked messages are not wanted, and back on later.

skills.label: Keep a project's files in its channel
skills.desc: Keep the files for a subject in its channel's folder, where every task in that channel can read them.

skills.label: Start a channel for a project
skills.desc: Ask for a channel for one task or project so its conversation, tasks and notes stay apart from the main chat.

skills.label: Answer a yes or no question with a reaction
skills.desc: Use a thumbs-up or thumbs-down on a yes or no question as the answer; a step that spends money or deletes for good still needs a yes in words.

skills.label: Ask in the main chat
skills.desc: Send a request by text or voice in the main chat and get the answer, or one line saying the work has started and on which task.

skills.label: Steer work already under way
skills.desc: Send a follow-up about work already started, such as a change of scope or a new detail, so it reaches that task without starting a new one.

skills.label: Ask what Claude remembers
skills.desc: Ask what Claude knows about you and your work, and get it in plain words.

skills.label: Correct or forget a memory
skills.desc: Correct a wrong note or ask Claude to forget something, and it is changed or removed and not brought back.

skills.label: Give Claude a standing rule
skills.desc: Say a rule in your own words, such as never booking before 10, and Claude says it back and works by it from then on.

skills.label: Schedule a routine
skills.desc: Ask for work that repeats on a schedule, such as a weekly preview, and say what each run should look at and post.

skills.label: Set a one-time reminder
skills.desc: Ask for a reminder at a set time; it arrives once as a message in the chat.

skills.label: Watch for something at set times
skills.desc: Ask Claude to look for a change, such as a reply or a price, at set times, and be told when it happens.

skills.label: Follow a task thread
skills.desc: Open the thread of a task to see its status checklist grow step by step while the work runs.

skills.label: Read a task report
skills.desc: Read the report a task leaves when it stops: the answer or what is needed, what was done in the person's name, what could not be checked, and the one thing to tap or answer.

skills.label: Write to a task in its thread
skills.desc: Write in a task's own thread to answer its question, add a detail or redirect it, and get a reply there.

skills.label: Mark a task done
skills.desc: Mark a finished task done, or say it is not done yet so the work goes on.

skills.label: Review a task that is ready for you
skills.desc: Open a task marked ready for you, look at the draft, result or question, and answer or act on it.

skills.label: Unblock a stopped task
skills.desc: Read why a task stopped, such as an app to connect or a reply from someone else, and give what it waits on.
